Quest name: Search for the Vanished Star (Chrono Quest - 19th Century)
Quest location: Stockholm Adventurers' Guild
Skill requirement: r11 Recognition, r13 Astronomy, GER(German)
Pre-requisite discovery: Saturn discovery (from "A Planet with Ears" quest) + Halley's Comet discovery (from "The Appearance of a Prophesized Comet" quest)
